publish.never: Not published yet: visitors see the growing note
publish.pending: Your changes are in the draft and not visible to visitors yet.
publish.upToDate: Visitors see the same content as the draft.
publish.confirmFull: Visitors will see the full page exactly as it is in the draft preview now.
publish.confirmNote: Visitors will see the “still growing” note instead of the full page, with the texts of the draft.
publish.fullDone: Published: visitors see the full page.
publish.noteDone: Published: visitors see the growing note.
